bio.text: Yvette Benarroch represents District 81 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2024, according to the House's official biography.
The profile lists Benarroch as a small business owner from Marco Island who was born in San Juan, Puerto Rico, and moved to Florida in 2003.
Benarroch served in the United States Air Force from 1990 to 1992, including during Operation Desert Shield/Desert Storm.
